answer: Locks are recorded in vertex, expire in falcon, and walnut lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 44 aliases thus needs 151 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4841 identities would post 949 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
